title: My First Day at Work in a New Country

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The First Morning
paragraphs: Three weeks ago, I moved to a new country.
I came here alone, with one big suitcase and a small dream.
Today is my first day at work.
I have a job in a small café near the train station.
I am happy, but I am also very nervous.
I can read well, but speaking is hard for me.
Last night, I wrote ten useful sentences in my notebook.
At six thirty, I walk to the café.
The street is quiet and cold.
I stop in front of the door and take a deep breath.
"You can do this, Maya," I say to myself.

words: a little afraid before something new
breathe in slowly to feel calm
